subject.title: WhatsApp: support pre-built link previews in sendMessage + batch send RPC method

question: Which scope should OpenClaw accept for this issue: staged pre-built WhatsApp linkPreview pass-through only, full automatic-preview plus batch Gateway design, or no core/plugin change?
rationale: The pass-through is dependency-supported and narrow, but automatic URL fetching and a new batch RPC are security/protocol choices that require maintainer intent.

options.title: Stage pass-through first
options.body: Implement the typed pre-built linkPreview pass-through now and leave automatic fetching plus batch RPC for separate maintainer-reviewed designs.

options.title: Design full scope
options.body: Keep all three requested capabilities together and require a broader protocol/security design before implementation starts.

options.title: Reject supported surface
options.body: Decline these additions and keep custom batching or preview workflows outside the supported Gateway protocol.

recommendation.title: Stage pass-through first
recommendation.body: Implement the typed pre-built linkPreview pass-through now and leave automatic fetching plus batch RPC for separate maintainer-reviewed designs.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest routing signal from the related issue consolidation and current-main ownership evidence for this WhatsApp/Gateway boundary.
